body: KEYBOARD NAVIGATION TEST - exam.html entry to score display. TAB ORDER: nav link back-to-dashboard -> section heading -> first question input -> hint button -> submit button. Each question: input -> hint button -> (if radio: radio options via arrow keys). Graph questions: canvas is not keyboard accessible - requires pointer. This is a known WCAG 2.1.1 failure for graph questions. Fix spec: add keyboard alternative to graph canvas (e.g. coordinate entry inputs). FOCUS STATES: hint buttons show browser default focus ring. Submit button shows default ring. No custom focus styling in current CSS. Improvement: add :focus-visible outline at 3:1 contrast. TRAPS: no focus traps found. After grade submission: focus lands on score section (browser default scroll-to). CTA button after score is reachable via tab. FINDINGS: 1 hard failure (graph canvas keyboard inaccessible), 2 improvements (custom focus ring, focus-on-score after submit). Filing graph keyboard spec to GA separately.
